scope: host parity relative to CI; Docker improvements described per step

steps.reason: Existing clean commit/tree identity replaces Actions checkout; dirty state prevents canonical PASS.
Checks Python 3.14 and reports patch version; does not install an interpreter.
Checks every pinned direct dependency, no fresh pip install on host. Docker builds requirements-dev.txt including runtime dependencies.

Host intentionally has no managed PostGIS and never touches an existing database. Docker uses disposable PostGIS 15-3.4, internal network, no host ports, same SQL order/options; trust auth only on isolated network.
Same black arguments, invoked through current Python module.
Same flake8 arguments, invoked through current Python module.

Same pytest.ini/80 percent coverage policy and suite; adds machine reports. Host denies network and lacks CI database/real ignored datasets. Docker has isolated database; Linux image differs from ubuntu-latest.

gaps: CI_PARITY_GAP: Ubuntu runner provisioning and Actions event/permission semantics are external.
